title: Posts that mention all the tags
description: Bug report for a search helper that picks the posts matching a list of tags. Two symptoms: a post is returned when it mentions only some of the tags, and a tag written in capitals does not find a post written in lower case. Fix the program. The complete rule is: a post matches when every tag occurs somewhere inside the post text (as a substring, not necessarily as a whole word), ignoring upper and lower case; with an empty list of tags every post matches; the result keeps the posts in their original order and has no other changes. Texts are plain ASCII.
notes: Two bugs: the start returns a post when ANY tag occurs (and so returns nothing for an empty tag list), and the comparison is case-sensitive. Tags are never empty in the tests (substring semantics of the empty text are not exercised). Visible examples use one lowercase tag so that the start passes them.
